patches.fit_note: Exposed south face joins the new side returns. Fixed-size window frames, glass and bars occupy rebuilt variable-width wall bays; a solid upper band meets the new roof.

Native east flank has partial boundary gaps into the attached structure. Unsupported pane samples produce solid blank bays. Local original window projections remain collision-authoritative and can exceed one metre of visual offset.
Native north return follows the attached block. High original chimney and ruin features above the owned roof slab are retained.
Short solid return closes the stepped front joint. The rest of the west boundary remains attached to the existing wing; no invented full west wall is added.

cleanup_volumes.purpose: Remove the surveyed elevated source window wedge diagonally outside both touching facade rectangles. Exact volume U97.25..99.33,D42.42..43.7,Y52.5..59.8; all outside fragments remain.
cleanup_volumes.collision_note: Original source colliders remain unchanged. This elevated projection remains physical; helicopter clearance requires Unity verification. Original ground and normal plateau head clearance remain below the owned volume.

area_note: Footprint counts each surveyed rectangle once. Removed projected/surface areas count all old scan layers, ledges and both windings, so they can exceed the footprint.

wall_material_policy: All storeys use the same coastal concrete, including the barred ground-floor module; the source kit remains unchanged.

roof.boundary_note: The original broad interior surface is about 51 m high and does not support a roof at 59.8 m. The new closed slab therefore receives one matching static runtime box collider; original scan floors and colliders remain unchanged.

geometry_policy: Only visual fragments inside surveyed R/Y/depth prisms are replaced, including oblique window ledges. At retaining walls near-horizontal courtyard floors (absolute normalY >= .8) are preserved. All fragments outside the six planes are retained. Original scan asset bytes and MeshColliders remain unchanged; source UVs and normals outside the prisms are interpolated without remapping.
limits: Reconstruction covers the inspected attached tower block and retaining wall, not the whole island.
Opaque recessed window panes remain sealed by original wall collision. No new enterable room is implied.
The closed roof adds one matching static support collider; all original scan colliders and original floors remain unchanged.
Source side-window projections can differ from the new facade by more than one metre locally; ground access, camera contact and helicopter clearance require Unity verification.
Unity rendering, collision/camera interaction and performance remain unverified.
